thread:
erin: Heads-up: Scheduled regional network maintenance for eu-central on Thu 03/28 02:00-03:30 UTC. This will include an IPv6 fabric upgrade and a planned failover drill to the secondary edge pool. SLO window adjusted to 30m burn tolerance for that period. Please read runbook and ack. :warning:

jamal: Ack. Which edge pool will be target for failover?

erin: Target is edge-pool-eu-secondary. Traffic will be drained from edge-pool-eu-primary and routed to secondary via smart-routing policy 'regional-failover-v2'.

maya: Thanks. I'll update the dashboards and create an alert suppression for the maintenance window so we don't spam pagers.

chris: Runbook link? Also adding a pre-check step to verify KV cache warmup after failover.
erin: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/eng-sre/eu-network-failover (tl;dr: preflight -> switch -> canary traffic -> scale up -> verify KV warmup -> full cutover). Preflight commands are below.

ops-bot: calendar invite created: "EU network maintenance & failover drill" Thu 03/28 02:00-03:30 UTC. Organizer: erin. Attendees: eng-sre, eng-runtime, dst-ops.

chris: Preflight checklist (short):
```
# verify healthy endpoints\r
redwood-cli endpoint status --region eu-central --edge-pool edge-pool-eu-primary
# check KV cache metrics < 5% miss rate
redwood-metrics query "kv_cache_miss_rate{region=\"eu-central\"}"
```

oncall-sre: I'm on-call that window. I'll run the failover steps with erin and grab logs. If we see token spike >2x, we'll trigger rollback.

jamal: How will rolling SLO adjustment be communicated to customers? Any SLA implications?

erin: Customer-facing SLA stays unchanged. This is internal drill with SLO burn tolerance enabled for internal alerting only. We'll send a short postmortem if we find any customer-impacting regressions.

deploy-bot: Canary execution scheduled at 02:15 UTC. Canary traffic = 5% of baseline for 10 minutes. Job ID: canary-193845-canary1

deploy-bot: Canary completed: status=PASS, latency_p95 change=+8ms, errors=0. Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/193845-canary1

oncall-sre: Post-canary checks: KV cache warmup completed within 2min, tail-latency stable. Proceeding to scale secondary pool to target capacity.

maya: Suppress internal pager alerts for the maintenance window. External customer alerting remains enabled (ops runbook says to avoid noisy internal pages).

chris: Quick note: updated SLO dashboard to show 'maintenance-adjusted' view and added annotation for the drill window.

erin: Final step: rollback command if needed:
```
redwood-failover rollback --region eu-central --to edge-pool-eu-primary --reason "unexpected_latency_spike"
```

jamal: If anything beyond rollback occurs (e.g., KV corruption), we'll escalate to infra-incident and org-sla lead @maya.

erin: Thanks everyone. Please ack here if you're attending the window or assigned an action. We'll meet in #eng-sre 15m before start for a quick preflight check. :eyes:
